Inventory `.claude/skills/`, `.claude/commands/`, `.github/prompts/`, `.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, `.mcp.json`, and `.vscode/mcp.json`. Then fix all issues (auto or interactive per user preference) — creating missing `.github/prompts/` wrappers, flagging orphans for review, and syncing MCP server definitions. Never auto-merge instruction files; show diffs and ask for confirmation.
